claim: Sri Lanka recorded 507,704 tourist arrivals in 2020, down sharply from 1,913,702 in 2019 as international travel shut down during the pandemic.

metric.denominator: international tourist arrivals recorded by SLTDA
metric.source_definition: tourist arrivals, not tourism receipts or foreign-exchange earnings

bounded_by: Quantifies the tourism shock only; it does not by itself establish the share of the later sovereign crisis attributable to tourism.
